sources.snippet: Add EfficientFormerV2 model family, including efficientformerv2_s0, efficientformerv2_s1, efficientformerv2_s2 and efficientformerv2_l. Pretrained checkpoints of EfficientFormerV2 on ImageNet-1K are released.

sources.title: EfficientFormer - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: EfficientFormer Model transformer with an image classification head on top (a linear layer on top of the final hidden state of the [CLS] token) e.g. for ImageNet. This model is a PyTorch nn.Module subclass. Use it as a regular PyTorch Module and refer to the PyTorch documentation for all matter related to general usage and behavior.

sources.title: EfficientFormer - Qualcomm AI Hub
sources.snippet: EfficientFormer Imagenet classifier and general purpose backbone. EfficientFormer is a vision transformer model that can classify images from the Imagenet dataset.

sources.title: snap-research/EfficientFormer | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: EfficientFormer: Original models that pioneered vision transformers at MobileNet speed These models address the challenge of deploying transformer-based architectures on resource-constrained devices by optimizing both model size and inference speed while maintaining competitive accuracy.
